main_text.l: JOH. BUXTORFIUS, FIL. LING. HEB. PROFESSOR

HAbes hîc, Lector Benevole, quintam editionem Manualis Hebraici & Chaldaici Patris mei beatissimæ memoriæ, in qua cùm ipsemet in eo, quo usus est, exemplari, nihil immutarit, nec mihi hîc quicquam juris sumendum esse duxi, memor illius Sapientissimi Regum Salomonis, אַל תַּסֵּג גְּבוּל עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבוֹתֶיךָ Ne mutes Terminum antiquum, quem posuerunt Patres tui, Proverb.22.28. In quem sensum etiam Talmudici scribunt, לֹא יִשְׁנֶה אָדָם מִמְּטְבַּע שֶׁטְּבָעוּ חֲכָמִים Ne mutet homo quicquam de moneta, quam cuderunt sapien-

page.notes: The Hebrew lines are printed in Hebrew letters; transcription of the Hebrew is approximate. The Greek-looking mark at the foot is a printed signature/ornament, rendered as χ ʂ. Ornamental rule at the top and faint marks at the edges are not transcribed. The final word "sapien-" is continued on the next page.
